Rules:
- Propose at most 3 things, the most valuable first. Cite the ids of the facts each one relies on.
- Use numbers exactly as they appear in the facts you cite (rounding is fine). Never compute new numbers.
- narrow_segment (keep only attribute=value) or exclude_segment (remove attribute=value) only when the cited segment fact says 'clearly different' for the chosen campaign type, and in the direction it shows. A segment that is 'not clearly different' is a reason NOT to narrow.
- switch_channel only if the cited channel fact says the other channel is allowed and the goal supports it.
- choose_campaign_type if the goal fits another type whose past results are clearly better, citing both.

proposal.summary: Data bundle upsell has a positive lift (+0.93 points) and is clearly stronger for postpaid lines (+1.87) than prepaid (+0.54), while the audience is 69% prepaid, and about a quarter of lines were recently contacted with 871 at the 3-campaign cap.

proposals.title: Narrow the audience to postpaid lines
proposals.rationale: Past data bundle upsell campaigns were clearly stronger for postpaid lines (+1.87) than for other lines (+0.54), and prepaid lines show only +0.54, so keeping postpaid focuses the upsell where it has worked best. This does reduce reach from the current 37,288 SMS-reachable lines, so the manager should weigh the smaller audience.

proposals.title: Hold back lines already at the contact cap
proposals.rationale: 871 of these lines already had 3 or more campaigns in the last 30 days, and 9,287 (25%) got a campaign in the last 7 days. Consider suppressing lines at the cap or in recent contact to avoid fatigue, without changing the upsell content.
